description: Persistent memory for AI agents. Knowledge survives across sessions: recall past decisions, track evolving beliefs, detect contradictions via NLI, and build a knowledge graph over time. 60 tools over MCP, with FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling and spreading-activation retrieval. Runs locally on SQLite and Ollama, so no cloud account is needed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
